headlines.title: Costco Remains a Defensive Compounder Awaiting Its Next Leg Up
headlines.summary: Costco just posted its fifth straight earnings beat and rewarded shareholders with a strong monthly gain, yet its valuation leaves almost no room for anything less than flawless execution. Before adding shares near four figures, here is what the numbers actually say.

headlines.title: NationsBenefits Expands Member Access to Health Benefits Across Costco Stores Nationwide
headlines.summary: PLANTATION, Fla., October 27, 2026--NationsBenefits, the leading healthcare fintech and benefit outcomes company, today announced a nationwide retail integration with Costco Wholesale to roll out its proprietary Basket Adjudication Service (BAS). Through this integration, health plan members with a NationsBenefits Flex Card can now redeem their benefits at more than 600 participating Costco Wholesale warehouses across the United States.

headlines.title: Is Costco Wholesale (COST) Fully Valued After Pharmacy Growth And AI Search Gains?
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) is in the spotlight after nearly 20% pharmacy sales growth and rapid gains from AI driven website searches highlighted how the retailer is using healthcare and digital tools to deepen member engagement. Those pharmacy gains and AI driven online conversions are landing against a strong tape for Costco Wholesale, with a 30 day share price return of 8.93%, a 17.63% year to date share price return, and a 5 year total shareholder return of 115.29%.

headlines.title: Own Costco Stock by Oct. 30 to Qualify for Its Nov. 13 Dividend. Here's How Many Shares You'd Need for $1,000 in Yearly Dividends.
headlines.summary: It's not worth owning Costco just for the dividend, but it's still an investable opportunity with plenty of upside potential.

headlines.summary: The company’s latest investments give members a new reason to renew.

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising consumer electronics, appliances, small electrics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, food courts, optical, hearing aids, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. Further, the company operates e-commerce sites; and offers branded and private-label products in various categories. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
